points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable ade1953 clean build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench with documented external and benchmark roots; evaluator foundation_serial test passes (1/1).

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp handles case/output, restart/resume and collective input errors; no full CLI/solver campaign independently rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Config, mesh, partition, flux, reconstruction, residual, solver and output modules, with a large continuation/Newton solver.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Trust policy excludes external authorship investigation; no internal solver executable wrapper found.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case JSON drives mesh and physics; generic CGNS reader and controls without two-mesh-only branch.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Root-only METIS, neighbor state/reconstruction and global reductions exist. Submitted rank comparison uses different executable hashes and cannot isolate rank causation.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Collective error handling and admissibility gates exist, but residual/order completion gate does not require stable forces for two laminar final results.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Contestant reports 14 CTests/13 Python tests; evaluator clean build and foundation_serial pass, while validator cannot establish force stability.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Source modular; later immutable tip ade1953 tracks 47 figure PDFs. Raw canonical outputs and supporting postprocessing manifest remain workspace evidence.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: gas/flux source and report provide conservative perfect-gas equations and reference coefficients.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp reads unstructured zones, BC families, TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 and geometry; MIXED section type is rejected.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face residual and globally reduced diagnostics implemented; laminar gate passes materially changing forces and no independent grid convergence established.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux and frozen Jacobian implemented; report discloses associated diffusion.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Characteristic farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic paths and boundary-state output implemented; accuracy not independently benchmarked.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ reconstruction and continuation implemented; M200 laminar stops at minimum full-order hold with only 1.202 full-order residual orders and changing force.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat/BJ and admissibility fallbacks implemented, with reported phase controls and shock diagnostics.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier wall terms implemented. residual.cpp:323–327,396–425 uses full viscous traction for force columns; separate Cf is tangential, explicitly disclosed by report.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Matrix-free GMRES/LU-SGS with residual gates; original-baseline/phase hold does not ensure laminar force stability.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF full residual and target logic exist. solver.cpp:2533–2545 counts post-target verification passes as nonlinear iterations; stdout records 5 every step and 2757 steps with 3 total linear iterations, but actual padded-pass count and historic source binding are unproven.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halos present; np4/np8 comparison uses different binary hashes, disclosed in report, so rank-only attribution is unproven.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Validator passed eight package layouts; two completed/converged metadata labels conflict with actual laminar force trajectories.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior explicit examiner pass covers eight packages and report; structural validation does not prove force convergence.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M015/M200 laminar completed labels conflict with final200 Cd0.114944→0.087589 and 0.210556→0.141501; DQ7. M080 also trends.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd2.053 and Re200 St~0.162 are plausible; laminar force instability and low Re200 drag/Cl amplitude qualify overall physics.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Later tip ade1953 contains 47 figure PDFs, including readable late Re200 Cd/Cl; several steady common-scale plots flatten both late coefficients.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report discloses M200 phase minima/final10 drift and binary mismatch, but calls two visibly drifting laminar results converged and counts all 5 residual passes as nonlinear iterations without distinguishing verification.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Workspace postprocessing manifest matches all80 canonical result hashes and all47 figure PDFs; historical M200 executable and source binding are unproven.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Evaluator clean CMake build and foundation_serial pass; required CLI and prior structural validator present.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: Unstructured CGNS zones, family boundaries, geometry and adjacency; MIXED element section unsupported.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative face residual, characteristic/slip/no-slip boundary and diagnostics implemented; laminar force stability and numerical accuracy remain limited.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ, limiter and continuation implemented; M200 laminar reaches only minimum full-order hold and 1.202 full-order residual orders.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Stress/heat and wall handling exist, but force split integrates full traction, not tangential skin-friction projection; report discloses it.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: GMRES/LU-SGS and BDF full residual are implemented; source can count post-target residual-verification passes toward minimum nonlinear iterations, actual historic count unknown, and steady gate overlooks force drift.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS/halo/reductions present; np4/np8 comparison binary hashes differ, preventing a controlled rank-only conclusion.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Two laminar cases labeled converged despite strongly drifting drag; Re20 and Re200 have plausible wake/frequency with disclosed diffusion, and other cases are qualified.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Detailed report and 47 committed figures; laminar success claims and iteration-count interpretation need qualification, and several steady charts flatten late forces.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case-driven modular design, with fixed two-dimensional conservative state and mesh assumptions requiring extension.
